content.simple_explanation: Learn Symmetry by understanding the main idea, evidence/examples and how to apply it.
key_points: 9 SYMMETRY Look around you — you may find many objects that catch your attention.
Some such things are shown below: Flower Butterfly Rangoli Pinwheel There is something beautiful about the pictures above.
In these pictures, it appears that some parts of the figure are repeated and these repetitions seem to occur in a definite pattern.
Can you see what repeats in the beautiful rangoli figure?

In the Reprint 2026-27 Chapter 9_Symmetry.indd 217 13-08-2024 17:05:22 Ganita Prakash | Grade 6 rangoli, the red petals come back onto themselves when the flower is rotated by 90˚ around the centre and so do the other parts of the rangoli.
